item.title: Integrating Root and Foliar Uptake Pathways To Dynamically Model Tissue-Specific Accumulation of Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances in Crops Based on Continuous Field Monitoring.
item.description:
Environmental Science & Technology · IF 10.8 · score 10.08
High-precision quantitative models capable of dynamically predicting per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) accumulation in crops are currently lacking. Existing models rarely account for multiroute uptake and lack validation under field conditions.
